evidence: In-line cylindrical dustbin and cyclone assembly with a trigger-operated handle.
Clear horizontal dustbin and rear exhaust filter cover mounted on a lower battery base.
missing_evidence: View of the rear circular LCD display to distinguish V15 Detect particle counts from the V11 lookalike interface.
Readable model identifier or attached illuminated cleaner head.
contradictions: The in-line horizontal dustbin layout visibly contradicts the perpendicular bin design of the V8 Absolute family.
decision.retake: Photograph the rear circular LCD display while powered on to view the interface.

candidate_checks.evidence: The in-line horizontal dustbin contradicts the perpendicular bin layout of the V8 Absolute.
The in-line body and trigger handle match V15, but distinguishing details from the V11 lookalike cannot be verified without the rear display.
The visible finger trigger and full-size bin proportions contradict the push-button operated slim body of the V12 Detect Slim.

o1.refinement_reason: Inspect the rear face of the exhaust filter to verify the LCD screen interface.
